source: MASAF national register of monumental trees (CC BY 4.0) cross-read against the Friuli Venezia Giulia regional list, ALLEGATO A al DPReg 071/2025, which adds a place name and the legal criteria for each designation. 47 register entries in the comune of Trieste; 8 published, the rest here.
context: Trieste holds the densest monumental-tree cluster in the Italian register: 12 entries inside 300 m at Parco di Miramare and 13 inside about 250 m in the Giardino Pubblico Muzio de Tommasini. Neither register carries an age field or a vitality field, so every lead below is unaged and unchecked for whether the tree still stands.
